title: Numbers in tarot and what they signal
description: Numbers in tarot, Ace to Ten: what each number tends to signal across the four suits, and how to combine a number with a suit to read an unfamiliar card.

scenes.headline: Numbers in tarot and what they signal
scenes.caption: Each number from Ace to Ten carries a theme that repeats in every tarot suit. Knowing them helps you read a minor arcana card you have not met before.
scenes.vo: Each number from Ace to Ten carries a theme that repeats in every tarot suit. Knowing them helps you read a minor arcana card you have not met before.

scenes.headline: The ten numbers
scenes.caption: Ace: beginnings, two: balance and choice, three: growth and teamwork, four: stability and pause, then five: conflict and change.
scenes.vo: The ten numbers. Ace: beginnings, two: balance and choice, three: growth and teamwork, four: stability and pause, then five: conflict and change.

scenes.headline: Reading number and suit together
scenes.caption: The number is the plot and the suit is the setting.
scenes.vo: Reading number and suit together. The number is the plot and the suit is the setting.

scenes.headline: A simple arc
scenes.caption: Many readers see the numbers as a small journey.
scenes.vo: A simple arc. Many readers see the numbers as a small journey.
